versions.subject: Rule for Cron activity - file creation
versions.detection:
selection1:
   TargetFilename|startswith:
      - '/etc/cron.d/'
      - '/etc/cron.daily/'
      - '/etc/cron.hourly/'
      - '/etc/cron.monthly/'
      - '/etc/cron.weekly/'
      - '/var/spool/cron/crontabs/'
selection2:   
   TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/etc/cron.allow'
      - '/etc/cron.deny'
      - '/etc/crontab'
condition: selection1 or selection2
